programmes.d: The daughter of a prominent Deacon, Tamar is a lesbian and taught that her desires are not that of God. Tamar has suppressed her feelings for 16 years, until she finds herself falling for the only other woman in a ministry class.
The love is hot when Breanna meets coffee shop owner Malcom, but his fear of commitment might put it on ice.
Struggling with his finances working as a mechanic, CrimMane chooses the dope track as his side hustle, until a client offers him a dangerous proposition.
After the unarmed shooting of William King, a college bound black teen, by two white officers, a city is on fire as it seeks justice in these times of racial division.

After the sudden death of his mother, Mano embarks on a violent path that stems from his grief and causes him to spiral. He lives by the mantra of Romans 3:23: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.
An up-and-coming app developer with a troubled past, struggles to break free from childhood induced trauma while attempting to balance work, family and a chaotic love life.
When rising fashion designer Dante prepares to launch his brand, haunting messages and resurfaced betrayals from his former partner threaten to unravel everything.

Tobin is currently working through his trauma with a professional counselor. Meanwhile, there is a serial killer on the loose targeting sex workers, and several clues are pointing to both him and his troubled relationship with his mother.

Jasmine and her friends embark on a girls trip, as well as mend her heartbreak. She then meets John and is hit with a wave of feelings and butterflies. But when John starts to show his true colors, the girls end up in a dangerous situation.

Haunted by a failed assassination attempt, ruthless drug lord Kwame becomes obsessed with Aubrey, the woman who nearly ended his life. Consumed by revenge, he kidnaps her, setting in motion a deadly game of cat and mouse.
Detectives Trent Rollins and Latoya Cooper investigate a series of murders in which the victims all bear a mysterious symbol that's connected to a previous murder of a known artist, Preston Sacher.

Marcus is a ladies' man until he meets Nia, the woman of his dreams. However, Nia's brother has a psychic ability that threatens to expose Marcus as the player he is, leading him to extreme measures with deadly consequences.

Ashton, Isaac, and Terrell have dreams of making it big in the gospel music industry, and making an impact in the world; however, worlds collide when they meet the nefarious founder and owner of Titan Records, Rodney "Rod" Wallace.
Held hostage in a diner, ten very different people, learn they have more in common than it appears.

A medical assistant with dreams of being a poet, falls deeply for her new boyfriend. When she puts her dreams aside and him first, it leads her to find out that her prince charming is not so charming after all.
